name: Shadows Tell About You
source: You didn't get into college, the bills at home keep piling up, and the only job you could land is the front desk of the luxurious Stay Resort. Behind the polished facade, everyone, from the guests to the staff and residents, has something to hide. A story for adults.
translation: 你没能考上大学，家里的账单越堆越高，唯一能找到的工作就是在奢华的“留驻”度假村担任前台接待。然而在光鲜亮丽的表象背后，从入住宾客到员工与常住者，每个人都有着不可告人的秘密。一部面向成年人的故事。
